fusions.name: Scale Rattle
fusions.desc: A tail whip that deals 9 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Tumble Through
fusions.desc: Curls up and spins through a ring 3.5 tiles wide, dealing 16 damage to every enemy in it and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Rolled Up and Gone
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% and your dodge chance by 10% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Seams Close
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 12%, and you carry 8% physical resistance.
